No entry point

Readers leave without a trace

A woman who saves your post on The Niceness Trap but isn’t ready for coaching has nowhere to go next. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

No qualifier

The right clients look like everyone else

A senior leader ready to invest and a first-time manager just browsing both see the same link. Nothing sorts them before they reach you.

Linear growth

Every lead depends on the next post

1,942 posts in, demand still rises and falls with how much you publish. Writing more is the only lever, and it’s capped by your time.

Most of the women who follow you for your voice never get a way to pay you, and the few who are ready can’t be told apart from the rest.

With Pirie Jones Grossman

Sound familiar?

Being agreeable built your career. Now it’s quietly capping it.

  • You rehearse the point, then soften it so much nobody hears it.
  • You say yes to the extra project, then resent the weekend it costs.
  • Someone else repeats your idea in the meeting and gets the credit.
  • You know what you want to ask for, and keep waiting for the right moment.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

How The Niceness Trap™ works

Why the habits that made you easy to work with start working against you as you get more senior.

The three moments the trap closes

The meeting, the ask and the pushback, and how to spot each one before it happens.

How to disagree without apologising first

A simple structure for saying the hard thing clearly, once, and keeping the relationship.

How to say no to extra work and keep goodwill

Words that protect your time and still sound like the generous colleague you are.

How to make the ask

How to prepare for the conversation about the role, the scope or the raise you want.

Script 1 · “The softened point”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why your best point in the meeting didn’t land.”

Body

“You had it. Then you added ‘I might be wrong, but’ and ‘just a thought’. By the time you finished, the point was gone. That’s The Niceness Trap. It’s a habit, and habits can change.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the way out live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text crossing out “just a thought”.

Script 2 · “The extra project”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You said yes to the extra project. Again.”

Body

“Not because you had the time, but because saying no felt unkind. Here’s the thing: a clear no, said well, builds more respect than a tired yes. There are words for it, and you can learn them.”

CTA

“I’ll give you those words in The Niceness Trap™ Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera by the water, white shirt, natural light.

Script 3 · “The ask”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Still waiting for the right moment to ask?”

Body

“For the bigger role, the wider scope, the raise. The right moment rarely shows up on its own. The women who get heard plan the conversation, say it once, and stop softening it.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through how in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”
